title: Lead Recruiter, US & Europe
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a Lead Recruiter to own recruiting across the United States and Europe and help build the teams behind Zilliz's next stage of growth.

This is a senior individual contributor role with broad ownership across both recruiting strategy and execution. You will support technical and commercial functions, including Engineering, Product, GTM, and other business teams.

You will work closely with company and functional leaders to understand business priorities, shape hiring strategies, and deliver against them. We are looking for someone who can think strategically about where and how we hire while remaining highly hands-on in the market.

This role is based in our Redwood City office and is expected to work onsite at least three days per week.

title: Senior HR Manager, North America & Europe
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a Senior HR Manager to lead HR support across North America and Europe and help us continue building a scalable people organization as the company grows.

This is a broad, hands-on role for an experienced HR leader who is comfortable working in a fast-moving, international environment. You will serve as the primary HR partner for teams across North America and Europe, lead the regional recruiting function, and take ownership of selected company-wide HR initiatives.

You will work closely with business leaders, managers, global HR colleagues, external employment partners, and the recruiting team. The role offers meaningful ownership across both regional HR and broader organizational initiatives, with the opportunity to help shape how our people practices evolve as the company scales.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Cloud Platform
description:
We're entering our next phase of 10x growth: more customers, larger datasets, more complex AI workloads, and higher expectations for reliability, performance, and cost efficiency. You'll join a small, fast-moving Cloud Platform team building the core platform capabilities that run Zilliz Cloud at scale across multi-cloud environments.

This is not a standard control-plane platform role. You will work across both the cloud platform and database runtime, building cloud-and-engine integrated systems around Vector Lakebase so AI workloads can be scheduled faster, run more reliably, and serve real customers more efficiently.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Cloud Reliability
description: We're entering our next phase of 10x growth; more customers, larger datasets, and far higher expectations for reliability. You'll join a small, fast-moving Cloud Platform team that operates large-scale, multi-cloud, distributed database systems in production. This is a high-ownership role for engineers who want to move fast, build automation instead of toil, and take real responsibility for production stability.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Database Systems
description:
The Database Systems team builds the core engine behind Milvus and Zilliz Cloud Vector Lakebase; spanning storage, query execution, indexing, load balancing, resource management, and distributed system architecture. We build the next generation of vector databases around three Natives:

• AI-Native: Born for AI and Agent workloads, with native support for vector data and semantic retrieval

• Cloud-Native: Designed for elastic scaling and large-scale operation in the cloud

• Lake-Native: Built on a data-lake architecture that works naturally with data at massive scale

For this team, scalability, performance, cost efficiency, and reliability are the core engineering goals.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Vector Index Research
description:
The Vector Index team focuses on building the core vector retrieval capabilities behind Milvus, Zilliz Cloud, and Vector Lakebase. We work on making similarity search over massive embedding datasets faster, more accurate, and more cost-efficient, while continuously advancing ANN algorithms, index structures, quantization, compression, recall optimization, CPU/GPU acceleration, and high-performance retrieval frameworks.

This role sits at the intersection of research and engineering. You will read papers, evaluate new algorithms, build prototypes, and turn promising ideas into production-grade vector indexing and retrieval systems. We are looking for engineers who enjoy research, but also have strong engineering fundamentals, performance optimization skills, and engineering taste.

title: Enterprise Account Executive - South Korea
description:
About the Role

Zilliz is seeking a highly motivated and experienced Enterprise Account Executive to drive our expansion in South Korea. As part of our global Sales team, you will play a key role in building and scaling our presence in one of the most dynamic and fast-growing AI and data infrastructure markets.

At Zilliz, our Sales team is dedicated to accelerating customer success through innovative solutions and strategic partnerships. In this role, you will work closely with enterprise customers across South Korea, helping them navigate their data and AI transformation journeys using cutting-edge vector database technology.

As an Enterprise Account Executive, you will own and develop your territory, engaging senior business and technical stakeholders to identify opportunities, drive complex sales cycles, and deliver long-term value. You will collaborate cross-functionally with Solutions Architects, Marketing, and Product teams to ensure customer success from initial engagement through expansion.

Your impact will be critical in establishing Zilliz as a trusted partner in South Korea. With your passion for technology, strong enterprise sales acumen, and drive to win, you will empower organizations to unlock the full potential of their data and AI initiatives with Zilliz.
